title: Blow-up limit of the pulled-back chart integral (substitution and dominated convergence)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, B ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ of class C¹ on B and K-Lipschitz on B (K ∈ ℝ≥0), and c > 0 with c|u − u'| ≤ |ψ(u) − ψ(u')| for all u, u' ∈ B. Let u ∈ B and f ∈ C_c(ℝᴺ, ℝ). Writing Jψ(v) := normDet(Dψ(v)) (Dψ(v) = fderiv ℝ ψ v) and η_{x,r}(z) := r⁻¹(z − x) (SimonGMT blowUpMap), we have r⁻ⁿ ∫_B f(η_{ψ(u),r}(ψ(v)))·Jψ(v) dv → Jψ(u)·∫_{ℝⁿ} f(Dψ(u) y) dy as r → 0⁺ (Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ; Bochner integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → 0 < c → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → ∀ u ∈ B, ∀ f : C_c(Rn N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ v in B, f (blowUpMap (ψ u) r (ψ v)) * (fderiv ℝ ψ v).toLinearMap.normDet) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 ((fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap.normDet * ∫ y, f (fderiv ℝ ψ u y)))
